tools.name: atlassianUserInfo
tools.description: Get the current authenticated Atlassian user's account information.

tools.name: getAccessibleAtlassianResources
tools.description: List Atlassian sites and apps accessible to the authenticated user, including cloud IDs required by other tools.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Search the deferred Atlassian tool catalog and return matching tool schemas and operations.

tools.name: executeRead
tools.description: Run a read-only Atlassian operation returned by discover.

tools.name: executeWrite
tools.description: Run a non-destructive write operation returned by discover.

tools.name: executeDestructive
tools.description: Run a destructive Atlassian operation returned by discover.
